audit_items.proof_trace: `_verifyCanClaimExcessCapital` is unconditionally called at L335 and performs `MerkleProofLib.verify(proof, acceptedCapitalMerkleRoot, leaf)` where `leaf = keccak256(keccak256(abi.encode(investor, investedCapital - amount)))` — the function reverts on proof failure (L767-769). Neither `LegionFixedPriceSale` nor `LegionSealedBidAuctionSale` override this path, and `investedCapital` cannot increase after `publishSaleResults` sets the root because `invest()` is gated by `whenSaleNotEnded`.
